cautions: Almost no shade on the sunny path: carry water on hot days.
No drinking water mapped after the start: bring enough for your dog.
Cows may graze the meadows: lead short and go round the herd.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

textIt.Almost no shade on the sunny path: carry: Quasi nessuna ombra sul sentiero soleggiato: nelle giornate calde porta acqua.
textIt.No drinking water mapped after the start: Nessuna acqua potabile segnata dopo la partenza: portane abbastanza per il cane.
textIt.Cows may graze the meadows: lead short a: Nei prati possono pascolare mucche: guinzaglio corto e aggira la mandria.
